title: Agent-Based Test Assertion Generation via Diverse Perspective Aggregation
datasets: Defects4J2.1.0:112 eligible assertion-triggering bugs,667human FM/test-prefix pairs
2203 EvoSuite FM/test-prefix pairs for mutation evaluation
task: assertion generation on supplied test prefixes
input_setting: patch/test evidence identifies focal method; known bug-triggering human test prefixes with prior assertions retained. Public UTMapper extracts focal code from FIXED checkout; distinguish this from buggy-input end-to-end discovery.
author_relationship_evidence: Paper replication link and repository title/README explicitly identify AssertMate; substantive agents, static analysis, datasets and evaluator scripts public.
license: Apache-2.0 verified GitHub license and root LICENSE file
exact_models: Paper DeepSeek-Coder-7B-Instruct; exact served checkpoint/tokenizer not pinned publicly
Additional paper models Qwen2.5-Coder-32B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B
weights_status: No fine-tuning required. Public deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-6.7b-instruct exists and ungated, but is a CANDIDATE mapping, not proven exact paper checkpoint. Example config merely DeepSeek; no serving command supplied.
evaluation_route: UTMapper -> assertion candidates+probability reranking+Judge -> UTExecutor on fixed/buggy; EvoSuite integration scripts supplied. Original stored outputs/logprobs provide an offline audit route, not yet executed.
blockers: No local author code/model reproduction performed
Documented entrypoint requires missing config/basic_config.yaml; example schema llm differs from wrapper config.deepseek and lacks eos/response_header
DeepSeek wrapper references self.tokenizer without initializing it; exact vLLM serving/tokenizer setup absent
Documented first_round_speak_up.py defaults debug=True and single-response prefix=False path, not full5sample paper pipeline
Oversampling wrapper default10,completion max_tokens1024 versus paper5/4000; confidence computes exp(mean(logprob)) rather than arithmetic mean token probability illustrated in paper

Public data preparation uses fixed focal code and derives actual values/function categories from target assertions in some routes; reconcile exact final ActVCon experiment path before asserting no oracle assistance
Top-level requirements omit numpy/transformers/vLLM even though wrapper/runtime need them
Paper mutation experiment omits PR/BDR; killed mutant count alone does not establish false-positive-controlled oracle correctness
concept_fit: Strong for observation-point selection and expected-value reasoning. Parameterized utility methods and where-to-assert remain explicit open limitations; current rules are not a full behavioral concept model.
recommendation: Promote oracle-specific candidate, but downgrade claim of immediately runnable exact small-model reproduction. Best pilot requires authors exact model/config/pipeline reconciliation; do not reimplement silently.
